---
title: "Owens holdout analysis — sequence & junction classifiers"
---

```{r setup}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(knitr)

FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

PRED_CSV      <- out_path("owens/owens_predictions.csv")
PER_MODEL_CSV <- out_path("owens/owens_predictions_per_model.csv")

# Key physically characterized sequences (update as needed)
KEY_SEQS <- c("2B4",
              "ON-07-07CSF138VH-34_CH3a", "ON-07-07CSF138VH-49_CH3a",
              "MS04-2PH30-CH3A", "MS04-2PH11-CH4")
```

```{r key-seq-labels}
# Map sequence IDs → plot display labels.
# Edit the right-hand values to set human-readable names for all plots.
KEY_SEQ_LABELS <- c(
  "2B4"                       = "2B4 Control",
  "ON-07-07CSF138VH-34_CH3a"  = "ON-07-07#34",
  "ON-07-07CSF138VH-49_CH3a"  = "ON-07-07#49",
  "MS04-2PH30-CH3A"           = "MS04-2#30",
  "MS04-2PH11-CH4"            = "MS04-2#11" #,"MS04-2PH11-VH5"            = "MS04-2#11-VH5"
)
```

```{r load-predictions}
preds <- read_csv(PRED_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)

cat(sprintf("Loaded %d sequences\n", nrow(preds)))
n_jxn_na <- sum(is.na(preds$ms_score_exclusion_junction))
if (n_jxn_na > 0) cat(sprintf("  (%d with missing junction — junction scores are NA)\n", n_jxn_na))

cat("\n--- Sequence classifiers ---\n")
preds %>% count(predicted_class_exclusion, predicted_class_baseline)
cat("\n--- Junction classifiers ---\n")
preds %>% filter(!is.na(predicted_class_exclusion_junction)) %>%
  count(predicted_class_exclusion_junction, predicted_class_baseline_junction)
```

```{r ensemble-bar-normalized}
# Per-model junction exclusion predictions for KEY_SEQS, normalized to 2B4.
# Each of 20 models (10 unflipped + 10 flipped) contributes one score per sequence.
# Normalization: each model's score divided by the grand mean of 2B4 scores
# across all 20 models → 2B4 retains its own variance / SEM.
# Bar = mean ratio; error bar = SEM across the 20 models.
per_model <- read_csv(PER_MODEL_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Junction exclusion only; drop missing junctions
jxn_data <- per_model %>%
  filter(variant == "exclusion_junction", !is.na(ms_score)) %>%
  filter(sequence_id %in% KEY_SEQS) %>%
  mutate(display_label = KEY_SEQ_LABELS[sequence_id])

# Grand mean of 2B4 across all model runs — single constant normalizer
ctrl_mean <- jxn_data %>%
  filter(sequence_id == "2B4") %>%
  pull(ms_score) %>%
  mean(na.rm = TRUE)

# Normalize and summarise
plot_df <- jxn_data %>%
  mutate(norm_score = ms_score / ctrl_mean) %>%
  group_by(display_label) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_norm = mean(norm_score,  na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_norm  = sd(norm_score,    na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(norm_score))),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

# Factor order: 2B4 Control first, then remaining sequences ascending by mean
ctrl_label   <- KEY_SEQ_LABELS[["2B4"]]
other_labels <- plot_df %>%
  filter(display_label != ctrl_label) %>%
  arrange(mean_norm) %>%
  pull(display_label)
label_order <- c(ctrl_label, other_labels)

plot_df %>%
  mutate(display_label = factor(display_label, levels = label_order)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = display_label, y = mean_norm)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#31688e", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_norm - sem_norm,
                    ymax = mean_norm + sem_norm),
                width = 0.25, colour = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(panel.grid    = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), aspect.ratio = 1) +
  labs(
    x     = NULL,
    y     = "P(MS) relative to 2B4 control (mean \u00b1 SEM)",
    title = "Junction exclusion classifier — ensemble mean \u00b1 SEM, normalized to 2B4"
  )

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig3D_owens_prediction.svg"), width = 2, height = 2.5)
```

```{r results-table}
preds %>%
  filter(sequence_id %in% KEY_SEQS) %>%
  mutate(display_label = KEY_SEQ_LABELS[sequence_id]) %>%
  select(display_label, sequence_id, v_call, j_call, junction,
         ms_score_exclusion_junction, predicted_class_exclusion_junction) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("ms_score"), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
  arrange(desc(ms_score_exclusion_junction)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Key sequence predictions — junction exclusion classifier")
```
